title: Corpay to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Results on November 4, 2026
body_markdown:
ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 21, 2026-- Corpay, Inc., (NYSE: CPAY) the global spend management company, today announced that the Company will host a conference call to discuss third quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, November 4th, 2026 at 5:30 pm ET. Hosting the call will be Ron Clarke, Chief Executive Officer, Peter Walker, Chief Financial Officer and Jim Eglseder, Investor Relations. A press release with third quarter financial results will be issued after the market close that same day.


**Earnings call November 4th**


The call will be webcast live from the Company's investor relations website at[https://investor.corpay.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.corpay.com%2F&esheet=54625770&newsitemid=20261021156288&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.corpay.com%2F&index=1&md5=665eb8e2915c69344d45165f6feed33f) . The conference call can also be accessed live over the phone by dialing 1-(800)-445-7795 or 1-(785)-424-1699; the Conference ID is CORPAY. A replay will be available three hours after the call and can be accessed by dialing (844)-512-2921 or (412)-317-6671 for international callers; the replay conference ID is 11162812. The replay will be available through Wednesday, November 18, 2026.


**About Corpay** Corpay (NYSE: CPAY), the Global Spend Management Company, is an S&P 500 company with three primary B2B solution sets. Spend Management, provides corporate and virtual card programs and automates procure-to-pay. Cross-Border, helps businesses manage foreign-currency exposure and provides global multi-currency account solutions. Vehicle Solutions, controls fuel, tolls, parking and related vehicle spend. With Corpay, the more a business controls, the less it spends.


To learn more, visit[www.corpay.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.corpay.com&esheet=54625770&newsitemid=20261021156288&lan=en-US&anchor=www.corpay.com&index=2&md5=025e409f7679c845c4e7a897dd4aa623) .
